# Research notes: US x Iran effective ceasefire by August 31 (as of 2026-08-08)

**Summary:** The last US strikes on Iran I could confirm were the "heavy wave" of July 29-30. If that was the last qualifying action, the 14-day period runs to about noon ET on August 12, which matches this question's resolution time. A US strike that hits Iranian soil before then resets the clock. Several Polymarket pages and CENTCOM pages could not be fetched (the proxy refused them), so some dates come from search snippets.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL. The outcome depends on a "consensus of resolution sources", meaning news reporting and CENTCOM releases on US air or missile strikes that hit Iranian land.
- 2026-07-15: The Polymarket market behind this question is "US x Iran Effective Ceasefire by...? (2 week pause)". [polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/us-x-iran-effective-ceasfire-byptptpt-2-week-pause-20260715194822042)
- I could not open CENTCOM's releases page or the Polymarket page directly.

## 2. Current status
- 2026-07-29/30: The last qualifying US strike I could confirm. CENTCOM reported finishing a wave of strikes at about 10 p.m. ET on July 29, in retaliation for an Iranian "attempted surprise attack" on US forces in Jordan. Al Jazeera reported a "heavy wave" hitting Qeshm and Bushehr. Iranian media said a strike on a house in Qeshm killed three people. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/30/us-hits-multiple-targets-in-iran-as-irgc-pledges-retaliation-what-we-know), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/30/nx-s1-5913077/us-iran-updates), [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-07-30/news-1Pcg2L8su6k/p.html)
- 2026-07-31: Iran struck a US-used air base in Kuwait, calling it retaliation for the US strikes "a day earlier". [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/31/irgc-strikes-us-targets-in-kuwait-a-day-after-us-hits-iran-latest-events)
- 2026-08-01: CNN said no US strikes inside Iran had been reported in several days. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/01/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- Timing: if the last strike is dated July 29 ET, day 1 of the period is July 30 and it completes at noon ET on August 12. If the Qeshm strike is dated July 30 ET, it completes August 13. Iran's local morning of July 30 is the evening of July 29 ET.
- I found no reported US strike on Iranian territory between July 31 and August 8. Nothing has settled the question yet.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-08: Iran's foreign minister said Iran was "very close" to a deal with Oman on managing the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran said the strait would not fully reopen until the US ends the war. Oman warned that attacks on shipping could derail progress. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/08/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-08-05: Trump said Hormuz would reopen "soon". The Houthis claimed an attack on a Saudi tanker. A Gulf official put the chance of an Iran-Oman deal at about 50-50. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/05/world/live-news/iran-war-trump), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/5/iran-oman-us-close-to-hormuz-deal-what-do-they-all-want)
- 2026-08-04: Trump cited "very good discussions" but warned strikes would resume if Iran backs out. Iran denies negotiating directly with the US. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/04/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-08-03: Trump said talks would start Monday and called it Iran's "last chance". [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/8/3/iran-war-live-trump-says-talks-set-to-begin-tehran-urges-us-to-honour-mou)
- 2026-08-01/02: Trump called off planned strikes, citing agreed "perimeters of a deal". The pause depends on "being able to rapidly make a DEAL". [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/2/trump-cancels-iran-strike-says-deal-perimeters-reached), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/08/02/trump-says-hes-cancelling-strikes-on-iran-as-perimeters-of-a-deal-agreed)
- 2026-07-31: At a Cabinet meeting, Trump said the US would hit Iran "very hard". [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-us-trump-strait-of-hormuz-kuwait-jordan-air-base/)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-07-07 to 07-23: CENTCOM ran 13 straight nights of strikes after the earlier ceasefire collapsed. [CENTCOM](https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PUBLIC-RELEASES/Article/4554310/us-concludes-13th-night-of-strikes-on-iranian-military-targets/), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/13/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-07-24 to 07-28: A pause of about 4-5 days ended when strikes resumed on July 29. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/26/us-and-iran-hit-pause-on-strikes-for-second-day), [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/07/27/trump-interview-iran-bombing-pause)
- AP and PBS note a pattern: Trump announces strikes are halted, then attacks resume days or hours later. [PBS](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/amp/politics/trump-frequently-announces-hes-halting-strikes-in-iran-but-they-keep-happening)
- 2026-07-22: An earlier Polymarket contract with a July 18 deadline resolved No. [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/world/us-x-iran-effective-ceasfire-byptptpt-2-week-pause-20260715194822042)
- An April 7 two-week truce is a precedent for a 14-day pause that held. [ADN/AP](https://www.adn.com/nation-world/2026/04/08/newly-created-polymarket-accounts-bet-big-on-iran-ceasefire-in-the-hours-before-trumps-announcement/)

## 5. Other forecasts
- About 2026-07-16: The August 31 contract traded near 59%. [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/world/us-x-iran-effective-ceasfire-byptptpt-2-week-pause-20260715194822042)
- About 2026-08-02/03: A third-party price-history page said the August 31 contract rose to about 90-94% after the pause and the "imminent deal" claims. [geoodds](https://geoodds.com/odds/us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-2-week-pause)
- I could not find a price dated August 8. I found no Kalshi, Manifold or expert forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Whether an Iran-Oman Hormuz deal is announced, or the talks break down.
- Iranian or proxy attacks on shipping or US bases. The July 29 strikes were retaliation for exactly this kind of attack, and Trump has threatened to resume strikes if Iran reneges.
- About 2026-08-17: The 60-day talks window agreed in June expires, after resolution but relevant to US posture. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/04/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-08-12, noon ET: the 14-day period completes if there is no qualifying strike first (August 13 if the last strike is dated July 30 ET).
